description: List every document in a matter that has an uploaded file, oldest first with cursor pagination, each with its entity id, name, parent folder, file field id, file name, and media type. search narrows the list to documents whose file name or name contains the text. Documents without a file, and folders and tasks, are left out; use entities.list for the full table with column values.

cursor.description: Opaque cursor from a previous page to fetch the next page

search.description: Keep only documents whose file name or name contains this text, ignoring case and accents. Blank lists every document.
